newsitem.title: UK: Conservatives have broken tax pledge - UK's Blair.
newsitem.headline: Conservatives have broken tax pledge - UK's Blair.

text.p: The budget confirms that Britons will be paying more tax in the coming year than they did at the time of the 1992 general election, Tony Blair, leader of Britain's opposition Labour Party, said on Tuesday.
Blair was responding to the budget speech of Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke.
He told parliament: "Taxes will be higher at the next election than at the last." He said this breached the promises by the Conservatives in 1992 that they would get taxes down.
"Give with one hand, take with the other -- that is the record of the government over the years."
